purpose: Document first-party local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The public Makani landing route was reviewed and presents only an email/password login for the Sharkia Spatial Changes Unit. No login, credential testing, hidden API call or authentication bypass was attempted. The official GOPP urban-map page describes administrative/settlement-level layers (governorate, center, local unit, village, hamlet) and provides no property-parcel geometry endpoint. ESA’s state-property map inventory lists Sharkia participation but concerns government assets, not a public private-cadastre viewer. No public parcel feature service was found. Whether the governorate spatial-change database includes cadastral parcels, whether it covers this point, and whether an authorized public parcel layer exists outside the login-gated portal.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Sharkia Governorate Spatial Changes Unit application; public page shows login only, with no anonymous map/query.
Official General Organization for Physical Planning Sharkia urban-map page describing settlement boundaries and a governorate-to-village/hamlet hierarchy; not a cadastral parcel viewer.

Official Egyptian Survey Authority state-property mapping project page lists Sharkia among governorates participating in mapping/state-owned-land inventory; this is not evidence of publicly queryable private parcel data.
Official Egyptian Survey Authority describes its historic production of urban/rural property maps and property books; national scope only.

attempts.result: Official governorate application presented email/password fields; no map or unauthenticated geometry route.
Settlement hierarchy and urban maps described; no parcel-vector service.

attempts.method: GET official Survey Authority program page
